WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count, MIN(d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS earliest_update FROM `MOIRA_LIST` AS m JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS d ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST HAVING COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1) SELECT inner_cte.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, inner_cte.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST, inner_cte.member_count, inner_cte.earliest_update, ml.IS_PUBLIC FROM inner_cte JOIN `MOIRA_LIST` AS ml ON inner_cte.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects AS ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats AS drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC

ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units,
